name: breezy_hr-mcp
description: Breezy HR (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_breezy_hr_api_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BREEZY_HR_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_breezy_hr_api_token.description: Breezy Personal Access Token (prefix breezy_pat_) from the Breezy app: user icon > My Settings > API Keys > Create API Key; sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. It acts as the Breezy user who created it.

platform_mcp_breezy_hr_company_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BREEZY_HR_COMPANY_ID
platform_mcp_breezy_hr_company_id.description: The Breezy company id (12-14 character hex `_id` from GET /v3/companies) whose positions are read.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v3/user returns the authenticated user (_id, email_address, name, username).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Employer ATS API: GET /v3/company/{company_id}/positions?state=published lists the configured company's OWN published positions (not a cross-company job search). There is no keyword or location filter, so query/location are not sent — filter client-side. Paging: page_size ('capped at 50') + page (1-based). id is the position _id (use it with get_posting); salary period is in raw.salary.period; department, type, experience, friendly_id and location.is_remote are in raw. There is no public posting URL field, so url is null.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /v3/company/{company_id}/position/{position_id}: 'full details (name, type, state, location, department, description, application form configuration, salary range, custom attributes, and team/admin…)'.
